_comment: EXAMPLE merge-manifest for the vortacraftmc/core mergeDatapacks task. Copy to packs/merge-manifest.json and edit. Only 'output' + 'include' are required; everything else below shows its default.

output.name: merged-datapack
output._comment: min_format/max_format required for format 82+ (25w31a+); pack_format optional/legacy-only.

_gatedLoad: true (default): route every pack's minecraft:load/tick hooks through a generated <namespace>:load/:tick gatekeeper with per-pack toggles, debug and status. false = legacy plain union-merge of the load/tick tags.
_namespace: Namespace for generated gatekeeper files (default vcm_core). Must be lowercase [a-z0-9_.-]+ and not 'minecraft'.
_debugDefault: Initial debug-message state (default false). Players toggle at runtime with /function vcm_core:debug/on|off|toggle.
_killSwitch: true (default, needs gatedLoad): also generate the global /function vcm_core:enable_all|disable_all kill-switch.
_loadErrorHandling: true (default): build-time load/tick reference validation + runtime error log (api/report_error, errors, errors_clear) + per-pack load markers for status.
_strictLoadRefs: true (default): load/tick hooks that resolve to nothing fail the build; false = warn only.
_zip: true (default): also write build/<output.name>.zip next to build/merged-datapack/.
